title: What should Switchboard's main window be called now?
summary: You kept "board" for this feature, so the main window needs another name. Today it says Move to Board (the Window menu and a project's context menu) and The board is clear (when every project has its own window). Its window title is already "Switchboard".

why: "All Projects" says what it is, and it pairs with the project windows it competes with: Move to All Projects, All projects are in their own windows. It's also what Xcode and Finder-style apps call the window that lists everything.

options.label: All Projects
options.then: Rename Move to Board to Move to All Projects, and The board is clear to Every project has its own window, in the app and the docs.

options.label: Main window
options.then: Use Move to Main Window and say main window in the docs.
